    while left <= right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        mid_val = nums[mid]

        if mid_val == target:
            return mid
        elif mid_val < target:
            left = mid + 1
        else:  # mid_val > target
            right = mid - 1

    return -1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test cases
    print(binary_search([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 7))   # Output: 3
    print(binary_search([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 2))   # Output: -1
    print(binary_search([], 10))              # Output: -1
